The '''Jaguada garrison'''<ref name="DL" /> was a military unit that served during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]]. The small<ref name="DL" /> garrison of Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] was stationed<ref name="CSWE" /> in Jaguada's [[Unidentified population center|population center]]<ref name="DL" /> by the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CSWE" />
